sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Lets the patched app start by skipping Google's Pairip license check.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hides the promotional buttons you choose in the patch options.
Hides the social feeds you choose in the patch options.
Removes the app's microphone permission, which no feature uses.
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Skips the intro clip that plays when the app opens.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
